$comment: Single source of truth for email-rendering test cases. One real example email per rendering concern. Consumed by the JS engine harness (packages/email-body/__tests__/fixtures.test.js), the web wrapper tests (ui/web), and the native iOS/Android WebView harnesses — all platforms run the SAME @inbox2/email-body bundle, so these expectations hold everywhere. Expectations are asserted against processBody(html) output. See README.md.
